reference.notes:
I've left this test failing, because the spec doesn't support it, and I made no code changes.

The test asserts `toolVersionOf("slice") === "slice@3"`. The spec says `SLICE_TOOL_VERSION` is now `"slice@4"`, and that `toolVersionOf("slice")` returns `slice@4`. The new tests in `workspace-stubs.versions.test.ts` check exactly that, and one of them asserts `SLICE_TOOL_VERSION !== "slice@3"`. So this test and the spec's tests can't both pass.

That version check is the only thing failing in the test. I ran a temporary compiled copy with just that expectation changed to `slice@4`, and the whole test passed; I deleted the copy afterwards. The readiness behaviour it covers still works as before.

test/slice.test.ts :: readiness needs full coverage and no blockers :: asserts `toolVersionOf("slice") === "slice@3"`, but the spec bumps `SLICE_TOOL_VERSION` to `"slice@4"`, which the `workspace-stubs.versions` tests require
